question:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing right back, Bob is playing left midfielder, and Claire is playing cheerleader.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Alice and Claire trade positions. Then, Claire and Bob trade positions. Finally, Alice and Claire trade positions. At the end of the match, Claire is playing
Options:
(A) right back
(B) left midfielder
(C) cheerleader
solution:
Each row lists positions in order: Alice | Bob | Claire.
Initial: right back | left midfielder | cheerleader
1. Alice swaps with Claire: cheerleader | left midfielder | right back
2. Claire swaps with Bob: cheerleader | right back | left midfielder
3. Alice swaps with Claire: left midfielder | right back | cheerleader
Claire is the cheerleader, option (C).
Final answer: (C)
